answer: Forecast agents selling crystal sensor readings must pay a nonrefundable fee for each signed market action, whether predicting a zephyr or a gale. Validators charge per accepted action and grant no free quota per account. A thousand aliases therefore cannot obtain a thousand free quotas; extra actions require extra payment in a scarce settlement asset. Price the fee against the expected spam payoff, while honest clients cap their spending. Wealthy attackers can still pay.
